subject.title: [Feature]: Diffs viewer: per-file +/- stats and multi-file summary navigation

question: Should the Diffs plugin ship the linked SSR changed-files summary/navigation and static-export toolbar suppression as the intended viewer/export UX?
rationale: The code path is bounded and a candidate PR exists, but this is a protected maintainer-labeled feature that changes user-visible viewer and exported artifact output.

options.title: Review And Land Candidate PR
options.body: Accept the current Diffs plugin UX direction and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100753 as the implementation path.

options.title: Request Narrower Scope
options.body: Keep the issue open but ask the PR to split summary/navigation from static-export toolbar suppression if those need separate UX approval.

options.title: Defer Viewer UX
options.body: Leave the feature in backlog and close or pause the linked PR if maintainers do not want this viewer/export behavior now.

recommendation.title: Review And Land Candidate PR
recommendation.body: Accept the current Diffs plugin UX direction and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100753 as the implementation path.

likelyOwner.reason: This account opened the issue and has the strongest recent history on the Diffs viewer implementation path.
